wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely BLANK -- no ink on any of its ~40 writing lines (the faint grey marks are bleed-through from the reverse of the sheet, checked at 200 dpi with -normalize; no glyph sits in any cell). Cover line 1 reads 0 in all three columns (plain '0' numerals in blue ink, not a nil dash), and line 2 (<=$50 aggregate, never itemized) likewise 0/0/0. THIS and CUMULATIVE both 0, so the scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) is entirely BLANK -- zero inked rows, verified at 200 dpi with -normalize. That is COHERENT with the cover rather than a gap: line 3 reads TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT 454.24 + TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT 0 = CUMULATIVE 454.24, so this 2018-12-05 summary report has nothing new to itemize; the 454.24 was itemized on the filer's earlier interim report, which is NOT in this chunk. The rows therefore sit on the PERIOD scope (they equal the this-report cell, 0), a DIFFERENT scope from the cumulative 454.24 the module publishes -- honest and expected. Empty here means 'nothing occurred this period', never 'no vendors'.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints no schedule total and no page subtotal -- honestly none. Both schedules are empty; the only anchors are the cover lines, and both close: contributions rows 0 = cover line 1 (0/0/0); expenditures rows 0 = cover line 3 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT (0).
gates.row_count: Not applicable to a row set of zero: both grids were read full-page at 200 dpi and again -normalize'd to raise faint pencil, and every band on both p2 and p3 is empty of ink. No rowbands run needed to count zero rows; the visual pass is the check.
gates.geometry_proof: No rows on either side, so there is no row box to prove. Recorded rather than skipped.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end of period): LAST 454.24, THIS 0, CUMULATIVE 454.24. Read as a balance the chain does not close -- beginning 0 + contributions 0 - expenditures 454.24 = -454.24, not +454.24; like the other 2018 Carr filers in this chunk, the filer copied the line-3 expense figure down into the balance line instead of entering a net balance. FILER arithmetic, retained verbatim. The line-1/line-2/line-3 identity LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE closes exactly on every line (0+0=0, 0+0=0, 454.24+0=454.24). No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain could be run.

escalation_note: p1 cover totals block at 600 dpi (confirmed the line-1/line-2 cells hold plain '0' numerals, and that 454.24 sits in the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns with 0 in THIS). p2 and p3 re-read at 200 dpi with magick -normalize to rule out faint pencil before declaring both schedules empty.
